title: U.S. awards GlobalFoundries up to $1.5B CHIPS grant

sources.quote: Department of Commerce have announced an award of up to $1.5 billion in direct funding to GF through the CHIPS and Science Act.

explain: The Commerce Department agreed to give chipmaker GlobalFoundries grants of up to $1.5 billion to build a new factory and modernize existing ones in Malta, New York and Burlington, Vermont.
